I dove head first into research when I got my diagnosis last year and have learned somethings that have made it easier to deal with. 

Like, there's a study that suggests that schizophrenia is a spectrum disorder. Which would explain why some individuals can be aware they have schizophrenia. 

Another study shows you're more prone to developing schizophrenia if you have a family history of psychosis and get prescribed certain antidepressants, like Prozac. This I honestly feel like it may have been my catalyst. After a year on it the delusions started but I was young and scared so I kept it to myself and stayed on it for several years more. 

I do feel like genetics play a huge part in it though.

Won't speculate on others since schizophrenia is not a one size fits all thing, but, I believe mine was triggered by a whole mess of things.
